tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Apacer AH355 128GB USB 3.2 Gen 1 Flash Drive is a reliable and high-performance portable storage solution. With 128GB capacity and USB 3.2 Gen 1 interface, it allows fast and efficient data transfer for documents, photos, videos, and other files.


Its compact and lightweight design makes it perfect for students, professionals, and home users who need portable storage on the go. The flash drive is backward compatible with USB 2.0, ensuring wide compatibility across laptops, desktops, smart TVs, and other USB-enabled devices.


Upgrade your data storage with the Apacer AH355 128GB USB 3.2 Gen 1 Flash Drive, available at the best price in Bangladesh from D CORE.


Key Features


  • Capacity: 128GB
  • Interface: USB 3.2 Gen 1
  •  Backward Compatible with USB 2.0
  • Compact & Lightweight Design
  • Plug & Play – No Drivers Needed
  • Portable & Durable
  • Compatible with Laptops, Desktops, Smart Devices
